replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, The Two Forts, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you make the map less flat and to expand the islands &or add more islands. The map looks very stalematey from the monument positionings and how the map is laid out. You should expand the island and make it less small.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may improve the map then resubmit it here.
